item: row 438 (with row 380): files with another name elsewhere (hard links) in both erasers; keys walked by handle
summary: The link count is read by fstat on the handle about to be written. Only the app's own, positively, is overwritten whatever its other name: a key file only when every name of it is in keys or keys/.pending (R841; an unverified one never written, name removed, 'may still be readable through that other name'), a store's page 1 and logs, the columnar salt, a segment or copy a record names by identity, a plaintext store log whose header ties it by page size; said 'overwritten all the same'. Any other file is never written, its name removed, counted once by identity, 'contents may remain under that other name', not clean. A possible corpus copy not positively the app's (a segment or copy with no matching record, an untied plaintext log) is left whole and said so. Four strings x12. Row 380 (R810): keys folder opened once no-follow and walked by its handle; an unreadable link count counts as more than one. The at-rest record stays refused (R840).
